parsed.rationale: One of the two participating records lives at 'Shared/Wallpaper/Examples/WallpaperSampleApp/Sources/DebugHUD.swift' in the Wallpaper package, which sits under an Examples/WallpaperSampleApp path — a canonical sample-app location. Per the restraint rules, any cluster containing a sample-app record must default to no-action, because lifting the production DebugPanel definition into shared code would couple production semantics to demonstration code. The production record in 'Shared/DebugPanel/Sources/DebugPanel/DebugHUD.swift' is intentionally separate from the sample-app mirror.
